name: tessa
description: Drive the Tessa QA harness from Claude Code: connect, discover a target, run scenarios, explain findings.

api_url.title: Tessa API URL
api_url.description: Base URL of the Tessa API, for example http://localhost:8000

api_token.title: Tessa personal token
api_token.description: Personal token minted on the Tessa page Settings, Tokens. It starts with ipt_ and is stored in the OS credential store.

watch_targets.title: Targets to watch
watch_targets.description: Target ids whose findings and runs should reach this session. Optional.

channel.title: Push channel
channel.description: Turn on the push channel (research preview, needs the development channels flag).
